resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, all effective Bengali runtime entries, prior review metadata, and Bengali technical terminology searches were available.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation, runtime inspection, and TypeScript checking passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: Three complete-scope passes resolved 75 formula, calculator, shared-interface, and technical-concept findings.

competentHumanReview.summary: The Bengali corrections were machine-reviewed and still require competent human review.

publicationAuthorization.summary: This cycle authorizes a locale-specific commit only, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Twenty-five concept entries exposed literal Unicode escapes, altered formula digits or unit symbols, and confused electrical power with energy.
evidence: Sixteen visible entries displayed literal escape text such as \u03a9.
A Kirchhoff formula replaced Latin digits with Bengali digits.
The electrical-heating heading rendered power as energy.
findings.resolution: Restored symbols, formula notation, SI units, TCR values, heat-flux terminology, and exact electrical meaning.

findings.summary: Twenty-five battery and mod-range entries confused mod with mode, power with energy, or left incomplete and ungrammatical limit labels.
evidence: The regulated-mod calculator repeatedly used the Bengali word for mode.
Several no-limit messages were noun fragments rather than complete statuses.
Battery runtime guidance used a literal device-overhead calque.
findings.resolution: Added effective Bengali calculator corrections for battery safety, runtime, regulated mods, resistance limits, power curves, and median labels.

findings.summary: Twenty-five shared and concept entries translated electric current as present-time current and reversed a non-removable battery warning.
evidence: The non-removable battery profile was described as removable.
Several circuit explanations used বর্তমান, meaning present/current-in-time, for electric current.
Control boards and mods used inconsistent, ambiguous labels.
findings.resolution: Corrected battery access, electric-current terminology, mod and control-board labels, and Ohm/Kirchhoff explanations.
